21227.page_note: Medical Center EMS (Med Center Health) answers 911 ambulance calls in Warren County and is the only ambulance service licensed for 911 in the county on the state list of August 2026. TriStar Greenview Hospital won state approval in 2023 to start a second ambulance service and said in January 2024 it would begin in 2025; it holds no ambulance licence on the August 2026 state list and in August 2024 it said the ambulance project was on hold, and no report shows it carrying patients. Neighbouring services sometimes help at crashes on the county line.
